requirements.text: For each combination of playing position and college, how many NBA championships have those players won altogether?
Break the players down by nationality and team, and tell me the total number of MVP awards in each group.
For every nationality-and-team combination, what is the players' combined number of Olympic gold medals?
On each team, what is the largest number of NBA championships won by any one player?
What is the average number of FIBA World Cup titles among players from each college?
What is the average age of Lokomotiv Kuban players who are not Nigerian-American?
Among players whose draft-pick number is below one, what is the fewest Olympic gold medals held by a player on each team?
How many French players are there at each playing position?
How many American players are in the dataset?
For each team, total the Olympic gold medals of players who are either Nigerian-American but not Croatian, or who do not play for Bursaspor Basketbol.
Considering players with matching team and home-city records, how many have a known age for each college?
For each playing position, what is the average championship count of the players' teams, considering teams with a matching home-city record?
For every player nationality, what is the lowest championship count among their teams that have a matching home-city record?
Among players with a matching team record, what is the highest number of MVP awards won by a player at each position?
Group teams by their home location and report the total MVP awards won by their players.
For each team location, what is the fewest Olympic gold medals held by an eligible player when either the home city's GDP is above 100 or the player is American?
What is the average player age for each team when the team is based in Los Angeles or the player has won at least one MVP award?
For each team, how many players either play for a team based in San Antonio or have no Olympic gold medals?
Among players whose teams are based in cities with fewer than two million residents, how many players are there of each nationality?
For teams based in Boston, what is the highest championship count at each team location?
By nationality, total the MVP awards for players who are not on the Milwaukee Bucks, have won more than two NBA championships, or play for a team founded in a year other than 1949.
Among players born on March 23, 1919, what is the highest draft-pick number at each position?
How many players are there at each position whose teams were founded after 1946?
For every team founded in 1946 or earlier, how many players are on that team?
For players on teams founded after 1946, what is the average player age for each nationality?

compiled_queries.natural_language_query: For each combination of playing position and college, how many NBA championships have those players won altogether?
compiled_queries.sql:
SELECT "t0"."position", "t0"."college", SUM("t0"."nba_championships") AS "sum_nba_championships"
FROM "player" AS "t0"
GROUP BY "t0"."position", "t0"."college"

compiled_queries.natural_language_query: Break the players down by nationality and team, and tell me the total number of MVP awards in each group.
compiled_queries.sql:
SELECT "t0"."nationality", "t0"."team", SUM("t0"."mvp_awards") AS "sum_mvp_awards"
FROM "player" AS "t0"
GROUP BY "t0"."nationality", "t0"."team"

compiled_queries.natural_language_query: For every nationality-and-team combination, what is the players' combined number of Olympic gold medals?
compiled_queries.sql:
SELECT 
    T1.nationality, 
    T4.team_name, 
    SUM(T1.olympic_gold_medals) AS total_gold_medals
FROM 
    player T1
JOIN 
    team T4 ON T1.team = T4.team_name
GROUP BY 
    T1.nationality, 
    T4.team_name

compiled_queries.natural_language_query: On each team, what is the largest number of NBA championships won by any one player?
compiled_queries.sql:
SELECT "t0"."team", MAX("t0"."nba_championships") AS "max_nba_championships"
FROM "player" AS "t0"
GROUP BY "t0"."team"

compiled_queries.natural_language_query: What is the average number of FIBA World Cup titles among players from each college?
compiled_queries.sql:
SELECT "t0"."college", AVG("t0"."age") AS "avg_age"
FROM "player" AS "t0"
GROUP BY "t0"."college"

compiled_queries.natural_language_query: What is the average age of Lokomotiv Kuban players who are not Nigerian-American?
compiled_queries.sql: SELECT AVG(T1.age) AS avg_age FROM player AS T1 JOIN team AS T2 ON T1.team = T2.team_name WHERE T1.nationality != 'Nigerian-American' AND T2.team_name = 'Lokomotiv Kuban'

compiled_queries.natural_language_query: Among players whose draft-pick number is below one, what is the fewest Olympic gold medals held by a player on each team?
compiled_queries.sql:
SELECT "t0"."team", MIN("t0"."olympic_gold_medals") AS "min_olympic_gold_medals"
FROM "player" AS "t0"
WHERE "t0"."draft_pick" < 1
GROUP BY "t0"."team"

compiled_queries.natural_language_query: How many French players are there at each playing position?
compiled_queries.sql:
SELECT "t0"."position", COUNT(*) AS "count_all"
FROM "player" AS "t0"
WHERE "t0"."nationality" = 'French'
GROUP BY "t0"."position"

compiled_queries.natural_language_query: How many American players are in the dataset?
compiled_queries.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS american_player_count
FROM player
WHERE nationality = 'American'

compiled_queries.natural_language_query: For each team, total the Olympic gold medals of players who are either Nigerian-American but not Croatian, or who do not play for Bursaspor Basketbol.
compiled_queries.sql:
SELECT "t3"."team_name", SUM(DISTINCT "t0"."team") AS "sum_team"
FROM "team" AS "t3"
JOIN "player" AS "t0" ON "t3"."team_name" = "t0"."team"
WHERE (("t0"."nationality" = 'Nigerian-American' AND "t0"."nationality" != 'Croatian') OR "t0"."team" != 'Bursaspor Basketbol')
GROUP BY "t3"."team_name"

compiled_queries.natural_language_query: Considering players with matching team and home-city records, how many have a known age for each college?
compiled_queries.sql:
SELECT 
    p.college, t.team_name, COUNT(p.age) AS known_age_count
FROM 
    player p
JOIN 
    city c ON p.city_id = c.city_name
JOIN 
    team t ON p.team = t.team_name
WHERE 
    p.age IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 
    p.college, t.team_name

compiled_queries.natural_language_query: For each playing position, what is the average championship count of the players' teams, considering teams with a matching home-city record?
compiled_queries.sql:
SELECT "t0"."position", AVG("t0"."age") AS "avg_age"
FROM "player" AS "t0"
GROUP BY "t0"."position"

compiled_queries.natural_language_query: For every player nationality, what is the lowest championship count among their teams that have a matching home-city record?
compiled_queries.sql:
SELECT 
    p.nationality,
    MIN(t.championship) AS min_championships
FROM 
    player p
JOIN 
    team t ON p.team = t.team_name
JOIN 
    city c ON t.location = c.city_name
GROUP BY 
    p.nationality

compiled_queries.natural_language_query: Among players with a matching team record, what is the highest number of MVP awards won by a player at each position?
compiled_queries.sql:
SELECT 
    p.position,
    MAX(p.mvp_awards) AS max_mvp_awards
FROM 
    player p
JOIN 
    team t ON p.team = t.team_name
GROUP BY 
    p.position

compiled_queries.natural_language_query: Group teams by their home location and report the total MVP awards won by their players.
compiled_queries.sql:
SELECT "t3"."location", SUM("t0"."mvp_awards") AS "sum_mvp_awards"
FROM "team" AS "t3"
JOIN "player" AS "t0" ON "t3"."team_name" = "t0"."team"
GROUP BY "t3"."location"

compiled_queries.natural_language_query: For each team location, what is the fewest Olympic gold medals held by an eligible player when either the home city's GDP is above 100 or the player is American?
compiled_queries.sql:
SELECT "t3"."location", MIN("t0"."olympic_gold_medals") AS "min_olympic_gold_medals"
FROM "team" AS "t3"
JOIN "city" AS "t1" ON "t3"."location" = "t1"."city_name"
JOIN "player" AS "t0" ON "t3"."team_name" = "t0"."team"
WHERE ("t1"."gdp" > 100 OR "t0"."nationality" = 'American')
GROUP BY "t3"."location"

compiled_queries.natural_language_query: What is the average player age for each team when the team is based in Los Angeles or the player has won at least one MVP award?
compiled_queries.sql:
SELECT "t0"."team", AVG("t0"."age") AS "avg_age"
FROM "player" AS "t0"
JOIN "team" AS "t3" ON "t3"."team_name" = "t0"."team"
WHERE ("t3"."location" = 'Los Angeles' OR "t0"."mvp_awards" > 0)
GROUP BY "t0"."team"

compiled_queries.natural_language_query: For each team, how many players either play for a team based in San Antonio or have no Olympic gold medals?
compiled_queries.sql:
SELECT "t0"."team", COUNT(*) AS "count_all"
FROM "player" AS "t0"
JOIN "team" AS "t3" ON "t3"."team_name" = "t0"."team"
WHERE ("t3"."location" = 'San Antonio' OR "t0"."olympic_gold_medals" = 0)
GROUP BY "t0"."team"

compiled_queries.natural_language_query: Among players whose teams are based in cities with fewer than two million residents, how many players are there of each nationality?
compiled_queries.sql:
SELECT "t0"."nationality", COUNT(*) AS "count_all"
FROM "player" AS "t0"
JOIN "team" AS "t3" ON "t3"."team_name" = "t0"."team"
JOIN "city" AS "t1" ON "t3"."location" = "t1"."city_name"
WHERE "t1"."population" < 2000000
GROUP BY "t0"."nationality"

compiled_queries.natural_language_query: For teams based in Boston, what is the highest championship count at each team location?
compiled_queries.sql:
SELECT location, MAX(championship) AS max_championships
FROM team
WHERE location = 'Boston'
GROUP BY location

compiled_queries.natural_language_query: By nationality, total the MVP awards for players who are not on the Milwaukee Bucks, have won more than two NBA championships, or play for a team founded in a year other than 1949.
compiled_queries.sql:
SELECT "t0"."nationality", SUM("t0"."mvp_awards") AS "sum_mvp_awards"
FROM "player" AS "t0"
JOIN "team" AS "t3" ON "t3"."team_name" = "t0"."team"
WHERE ("t3"."team_name" != 'Milwaukee Bucks' OR ("t0"."nba_championships" = 2 OR "t3"."founded_year" != 1949))
GROUP BY "t0"."nationality"

compiled_queries.natural_language_query: Among players born on March 23, 1919, what is the highest draft-pick number at each position?
compiled_queries.sql:
SELECT "t0"."position", MAX("t0"."draft_pick") AS "max_draft_pick"
FROM "player" AS "t0"
WHERE "t0"."birth_date" = 'March 23, 1919'
GROUP BY "t0"."position"

compiled_queries.natural_language_query: How many players are there at each position whose teams were founded after 1946?
compiled_queries.sql:
SELECT "t0"."position", COUNT(*) AS "count_all"
FROM "player" AS "t0"
JOIN "team" AS "t3" ON "t3"."team_name" = "t0"."team"
WHERE "t3"."founded_year" > 1946
GROUP BY "t0"."position"

compiled_queries.natural_language_query: For every team founded in 1946 or earlier, how many players are on that team?
compiled_queries.sql:
SELECT 
    t.team_name, 
    COUNT(p.name) AS player_count
FROM 
    player p
JOIN 
    team t ON p.team = t.team_name
WHERE 
    t.founded_year <= 1946
GROUP BY 
    t.team_name

compiled_queries.natural_language_query: For players on teams founded after 1946, what is the average player age for each nationality?
compiled_queries.sql:
SELECT 
    p.nationality, 
    AVG(p.age) AS avg_age
FROM 
    player p
JOIN 
    team t ON p.team = t.team_name
WHERE 
    t.founded_year > 1946
GROUP BY 
    p.nationality
